prompt: Why does the speaker want the template in the photograph?
promptZh: 講者為什麼希望照片中有樣板？

options.text: She needs a record of the writing on the box.
options.zh: 她需要記錄箱上寫的字。
options.whyZh: 她請人把樣板貼著窗框拍，不是拍箱上的字。

options.text: She wants to count the shipping clips.
options.zh: 她想數有幾個運送用夾具。
options.whyZh: 照片是在外形不合時拍；用途不是清點夾具。

options.text: She wants to see which part of the opening is not covered.
options.zh: 她想看開口哪一部分沒有被蓋住。
options.whyZh: 樣板在窗框上的位置能讓她看出哪邊尺寸不足。

options.text: She wants to check that the shutter has already been fitted.
options.zh: 她想確認窗板是否已裝好。
options.whyZh: 拍的是樣板比對，不是已安裝的窗板。

explanationZh: 樣板在窗框上的位置能讓她看出哪邊尺寸不足。
evidence: send me a photo with the template still against the frame. / I need to see where it falls short.
